mechanism_of_action: Monoclonal antibody against lysyl oxidase-like molecule 2 (LOXL2).
primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in liver-biopsy MQC (percentage of liver collagen) at Week 96 and event-free survival (EFS) through progression to cirrhosis or last dose (maximum 240 weeks).
efficacy_outcome: Mean change in liver collagen was −3.1 with SIM 75 mg, −2.5 with SIM 125 mg, and −1.9 with placebo. EFS comparisons were not significant (p=0.73 and p=0.85).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events in the blinded phase: 17/71 with SIM 75 mg, 17/74 with SIM 125 mg, and 14/74 with placebo; deaths were not reported. In the open-label phase, 11/42 had serious adverse events with SIM 125 mg; deaths were not reported.
